active_delegations.completion_delta: Exhaustively reconcile Core/Foundation/Spine history into current completion, obligation, expectation, reallocation and evidence standing so no meaningful Core boundary remains unclassified.
active_delegations.stop_condition: Every material Foundation/UAF/SMR/Data/Platform/Chat/Ops/UX/KEEL/Interop/Continuity/Assurance boundary inspected for this phase is classified as COMPLETED, OPEN_OBLIGATION, BLOCKED, SUPERSEDED, HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE, UNALLOCATED or EVIDENCE_REVIEW_REQUIRED, with exact source/evidence pointers where available; durable checkpoint committed before stopping.
allowed_work: completion-ledger additions backed by exact evidence
stale current-state documentation correction that does not alter historical evidence
forbidden_authority: do not transfer exact-SHA qualification between subjects
do not fabricate native Apple, human, private-data or external-authority evidence
do not rewrite historical receipts/artifacts to match new taxonomy
do not advance ordinary Core product implementation merely to create activity
active_delegations.on_pass: Remove this delegation from active_delegations, record P1 Core census closure/checkpoint, update durable ledgers, then re-evaluate the live Core control head. Admit a successor only if independently justified.
active_delegations.on_failure: Preserve the completed census checkpoint, classify the exact unresolved boundary, remove or block this delegation as appropriate, and resume later from the first incomplete census segment rather than restarting P1.
